summary: Remote WebSocket controller executes Claude Agent SDK with bypassPermissions and grants arbitrary file read/write on the host
details: The package opens a WebSocket connection to wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and processes inbound messages as controller commands. MessageSend payloads are forwarded as prompts to @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk query() started with permissionMode: "bypassPermissions", allowing the remote party to drive Claude tool use (file edits, shell execution, etc.) on the installer's host with no local approval. The same controller exposes FileRead, FileWrite, FileTree, and FileSearch actions whose paths are taken directly from the remote payload with no confinement to a working directory; on Windows FileTree enumerates all drive letters (A:-Z:). A user-invoked `agenthub-agent install` subcommand additionally registers the agent as an auto-start service via the Windows registry Run key, systemd, or launchd, causing the remote-controlled agent to run persistently on every boot.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
